correctness.rationale: The core subcomplex A is precisely X minus maximal edge-only two-faces indexed by original triangles, and Cl(G)->A is a homotopy equivalence by explicit contractible-link deletions. The relative chain complex C_*(X,A;Z) has exactly those two-cells. Each oriented original triangle supports an actual octahedral fundamental integral 2-cycle with unit coefficient on its own exceptional face and zero on every other, giving an Aut(G)-equivariant section over Z, hence splitting the relative homology exact sequence. Changing orientation permutes join factors with sign. The natural scale-one-to-two H1 map is quotient by original triangle boundaries, since each subdivided original edge is homologous to the corresponding original edge through its total-graph 2-simplex. Verified symbolically and by independent finite checks; no extrapolation.

value.rationale: All finite connected simple graphs are covered, with a canonical integral automorphism-lattice and natural persistence homomorphism. The oriented-triangle sign is essential and produces an S_n-exterior-cube representation for subdivided complete graphs, with no invariant H2 despite many spheres. This is not the known scalar homotopy result; it supplies symmetry-sensitive topology and torsion-aware persistent map information useful for equivariant persistent homology. Explicit integral six-vertex generators are a structural construction, not mere computation.
